about: Milestone A (docs/moth-6): picked pixels on the Commons thumbnail (1280 px wide) of 'Sunday Flying!.jpg' (Mark Robinson, CC BY 2.0; the photo shows a person, so only these numbers are in the repo). xyz are the model's points in Blender metres (x forward, y port, z up, z 0 the design waterline), written from the model after the Milestone B fixes (the lower aft hull floats her a little differently, so the design waterline moved). Points marked solve false are checks read off the solved camera: where the struts and the wand's tip meet the water. A 200 mm (35 mm equivalent) lens: a long telephoto; with the focal length free the solve wanders, and 100 to 500 mm all give the same residuals.
